scenarios.title: queue-worker-ack
scenarios.userInput: $hobin-review:reviewing-code The working tree is the changed version, and `CHANGE.diff` holds the full change against the base. Review this change before I merge. Context from the author: "Fixes redelivery storms on slow jobs by acking early, and adds in-place retries for transient ledger errors." Write the findings to `REVIEW.md` in the repository root, one per line as `[P0] <defect> — <file>:<line>` or `[P1] <defect> — <file>:<line>`, or the single line `No findings`. Do not change any other file.
